description: Lists company websites that use the named technologies (all of them) or any tool in a category, e.g. Shopify, HubSpot, Klaviyo, Stripe, Intercom. Filter by country, language, niche keywords and domain rank (0-1000 authority score). Returns domain, title, country, domain rank, matched technologies, key stack columns (e-commerce, CMS, CRM, payments, marketing automation, analytics, chat), company social pages and when the technology was last seen. Billed per domain returned plus a run start fee.

countries.description: Optional 2-letter country codes, e.g. US, GB, DE.

keywords.description: Optional niche words matched in the site title or description, e.g. coffee, skincare.

languages.description: Optional 2-letter language codes, e.g. en, de.

last_seen_within_days.description: Only sites where the technology was seen in the last N days (default 365).

limit.description: Domains to return (default 20, max 50). Billed per domain returned.

max_domain_rank.description: Skip sites above this domain rank, e.g. 500 for smaller businesses.

min_domain_rank.description: Skip sites below this domain rank, e.g. 150.

technologies.description: 1-5 technology names; a site must use all of them. E.g. Shopify, Klaviyo.

technology_categories.description: Alternatively or additionally: sites using any tool in these categories.

name: sites_using_technology
title: Websites using a technology
